description: This bar chart displays the percentage point difference in morphosyntactic probing performance across layers for two multilingual BERT models, mBERT and XLM-R, with the horizontal axis representing layer number (0 to 12, plus a "concat" category at the end) and the vertical axis representing the percentage point difference, ranging from -10 to 0 in linear increments. The top chart, labeled "mBERT," shows bars that are all light blue, with values ranging from approximately -10.0 at layer 0 to around +1.0 at layer 12; the bars for layers 6 through 12 are very short, indicating small differences near zero, while layers 0 through 5 show progressively less negative differences. The bottom chart, labeled "XLM-R," shows bars that are all dark blue, with values ranging from approximately -10.0 at layer 0 to around +1.0 at layer 12; similarly, layers 6 through 12 show small differences near zero, while layers 0 through 5 show progressively less negative differences. The bars are not sorted and are presented in order of layer number from left to right, with no visual emphasis such as shading or bolding applied to any specific bar.
